Verdict: the vendored copy is near-pristine. We changed 11 lines in 2 files. All of them are forced by QMK changes between the port's base and our pin (7a1bbf37c5, 2026-10-02); none is a layout or behaviour decision. Everything we own — Miryoku wiring, the vanos layout, the encoder-direction fix — lives in keyboards/cheapino/keymaps/, outside vendor/. Every licence and copyright header is kept as upstream wrote it.

Why it is vendored at all

The Cheapino is not in upstream QMK: tompi did not upstream it, and the community PR qmk/qmk_firmware#25817 (azzamsa) was closed unmerged on 2026-03-06. QMK External Userspace can add keymaps but not keyboards (qmk.path.is_keyboard() needs QMK_FIRMWARE/keyboards/<kb>/keyboard.json), which is why every Cheapino firmware elsewhere is a QMK fork.

Instead of forking, the board definition lives here and is symlinked into the QMK tree before each build: locally by kboards/scripts/link-cheapino.sh (mise task link:cheapino, which also hides the link from the QMK submodule's git status), and in GitHub Actions by the workflow's preparation_command.

Kept out of vendor/ on purpose

  • Encoder direction. fix_encoder_action() guesses "clockwise" from the order of the A/B contacts, and the guess is reversed on our units. The fix is keyboards/cheapino/keymaps/manna_harbour_miryoku/cheapino_encoder.h (encoder_update_user flips the direction), included by both keymaps. An earlier in-vendor patch (CHEAPINO_ENCODER_FLIP in cheapino.c) was flashed on both units on 2026-10-29 and then moved out; same behaviour.
  • Miryoku mapping. LAYOUT_miryoku → the board's 37-position LAYOUT_split_3x5_3 (encoder push = CHEAPINO_ENCODER_PUSH) is in keyboards/cheapino/keymaps/manna_harbour_miryoku/config.h.

Maintenance notes

  • QMK pin bumps can break these files (API renames like the GPIO one). After mise run submodules:bump in kboards, run mise run build:all; fix only what the compiler forces, and record it here.
  • Re-vendoring: check schuay's branch (unchanged since 4d41e564 as of 2026-10-29) and tompi's repo; copy the folder, re-apply the two diffs above, and update this report. If upstream QMK ever adds keyboards/cheapino, link-cheapino.sh stops instead of overwriting it — then drop vendor/.
  • Do not reformat these files (trailing whitespace, headers): keep them diff-able against upstream.
  • Human-readable background and build/flash instructions: kboards/docs/devices/cheapino.md and kboards/docs/devices/cheapino/qmk/README.md.
